title: 第二十三章 发现新天赋表面道友第二十四章 神秘莲花的影子
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
楚飞鹤此人，八面玲珑，谈吐也风趣，见识又广博，十分予人好感。
此人又刻意结交，没一会的功夫，就和赢商称兄道弟起来，一口一个赵老弟，赢商当然还是以赵河这个假名字自称。
聊了片刻之后，楚飞鹤继续去找其他修士。
“宝灵，他们几个里，谁觉醒了独门天赋？”
“只有楚飞鹤，他已经觉醒了第一门。”
“这个小子这么厉害吗？什么天赋？”
“表面道友——格外擅长结交各路修士，博取其他人的好感，为自己谋取利益，至于是真心还是假意，只有他自己知道。”
赢商笑了。
好一个表面道友！
听起来虽然与修炼无关，但身为一个老狐狸，赢商还挺欣赏这门天赋，修道也少不了人情世故，有几个光靠会打架，杀上巅峰去？
……
表面道友，果然厉害！
没一会的功夫，楚飞鹤就又拉来了两个修士，一个瘦长如猴的小子，名叫陆少夫，一个女道姑，名叫明玉真人，全是磐气中期的境界。
这两人背后的宗门，就不那么正派了，不过众人都没有反对。
到了这里，队伍已经有了七人，虽然大家境界不高，但规模算是不小了，商量了一下，都不打算再多耽搁，当天就上路。
七人一起，一头扎进了茫茫风雪之中。
……
进了山来，向东北方向去。
依然是在高高的天空里飞过，七人灵识铺洒着，注意着四面里的一切动静，赢商刻意控制，没有外放灵识。

高山！
深谷！
险壑！
一路过去，山势复杂而又多变，这里的山上，不知挤压了多少年的冰雪，不时可以听见轰隆的雪崩之声，滑落的冰雪，仿佛奔腾的大河一般，壮阔无比，将深邃的沟壑掩埋。
最前面的这一段，不知道被多少修士，搜刮过，清剿过，根本不见什么机缘雪怪，七人警惕的更多是其他修士。
一连三天过去。
七人越近越深，终于开始发现一些低级的雪兽，低级的天材地宝，基本不值什么钱，也懒得去取，继续向前。
到了第四天，大片大片的，灵识无法穿透的雾气，开始出现，这种类似人族阵法的手段，正是那些雪怪的巢穴的保护，半是天生，半是它们的妖云毒雾织就，一些十分凶险。连天大雪山范围十分广阔，修士即便进的多，依然有大量的遗漏之处。
而不知道下方藏着什么怪物，更多了变数，赢商以前，虽然来过，但保不齐这些地方，早就换了主人。
也从这里开始，七人遭遇攻击。
妖虫！
妖鸟！
妖兽！
一波波的怪物，轰击了过来，七人各显神通，展开反击和清剿，赢商施展的，自然是学自浪三刀的金行法术，表现中规中矩。
七人之中，表面看去，最厉害的还数楚飞鹤这个窜头人，一头风沙土法，施展的既迅猛凌厉，又仙气飘飘。
在这一场场厮杀里，七人收获，也渐渐多了起来。
算不上什么太好的东西，因此在分配上，也没有诞生什么冲突，队伍里一团和气。
……

Chu Feihe was a well-educated person, his conversation was humorous, his knowledge was broad, and he was very popular with others.
This person deliberately made friends with him, and within a short time, he and Ying Shang became brothers, calling him brother Zhao. Of course, Ying Shang still called himself Zhao He.
After chatting for a while, Chu Feihe continued to find other monks.
"Baoling, who among them has awakened his unique talent?"
"Only Chu Feihe, he has awakened the first gate."
"Is this kid so powerful? What kind of talent is he?"
"Fellow Daoist on the surface - he is particularly good at making friends with monks from all walks of life, winning the favor of others, and seeking benefits for himself. As for whether he is sincere or fake, only he knows."
Yingshang smiled.
What a superficial fellow Taoist!
Although it sounds irrelevant to cultivation, as an old fox, Ying Shang appreciates this talent. Cultivating Taoism is also indispensable for people and sophistication. How many people can reach the top just by being able to fight?
…
Taoist fellow Taoist, you are indeed amazing!
After a while, Chu Feihe attracted two more monks, a lanky boy named Lu Shaofu and a female Taoist nun named Mingyu Zhenren, both of whom were in the middle stage of Pan Qi.
The sect behind these two people was not that upright, but no one objected.
When we got here, the team already had seven people. Although everyone was not at a high level, the scale was quite large. After some discussion, we decided to set off on the road that day without any further delay.
Together, the seven of them plunged into the wind and snow.
…
Enter the mountain and go northeast.
Still flying high in the sky, the seven people's spiritual consciousness was spread out, paying attention to all the movements in the surroundings. Yingshang deliberately controlled it and did not release his spiritual consciousness.
Mountains!
Deep valley!
Danger!
Along the way, the mountains are complex and changeable. On the mountains here, there are countless years of ice and snow squeezed. From time to time, you can hear the sound of rumbling avalanches. The falling ice and snow are like a rushing river, so majestic that it buries deep ravines.
The first section had been looted and wiped out by countless monks. There was no chance snow monster at all. The seven people were more wary of other monks.
Three days passed in a row.
The seven of them got closer and deeper, and finally began to find some low-level snow beasts and low-level treasures of heaven and earth, which were basically worthless. They were too lazy to get them and continued to move forward.
On the fourth day, large swaths of mist that could not be penetrated by spiritual consciousness began to appear. This method, similar to human formations, was the protection of the nests of those snow monsters. It was half born and half woven by their monster clouds and poisonous mist. Some of them were very dangerous. The Snowy Mountains are very vast, and even if the monks enter a lot, there are still a lot of things they miss.
We don't know what kind of monsters are hidden below, so there are more variables. Although Ying Shang has been here before, he couldn't protect these places, and they had already changed their owners.
From here, seven people were attacked.
Monster insect!
Monster bird!
Monster!
Waves of monsters bombarded them, and the seven of them each showed their magical powers to fight back and eliminate them. Ying Shang naturally used the Jinxing spell he learned from Lang Sandao, and his performance was quite satisfactory.
Among the seven, on the surface, the most powerful one is Chu Feihe, a man with a head full of wind and sand, and the skills he uses are both fast and fierce, and have an air of immortality.
In this battle, the seven people gained more and more.
It was not a very good thing, so there was no conflict in the distribution, and there was harmony in the team.
…
